## Cheitan Fighter (CR 10)

**XP** 9,600  
Female cheitan human fighter 9  
NE Medium outsider (native)  
 **Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +7  

**Defense**

 **AC** 28, touch 13, flat-footed 25 (+1 dodge, +9 armor, +2 Dex, +3 natural, +3 shield)  
 **hp** 135 (9d10+36 plus 9)  
 **Fort** +12; **Ref** +8; **Will** +6; +2 vs. fear  
 **Defensive Abilities** bravery +2; **Resist** fire 20  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft., fly 40 ft. (perfect)  
 **Melee** +1 longsword +20/+15 (1d8+12/17–20) or 2 slams +17 (1d6+8)  
 **Special Attacks** weapon training (heavy blades +2, natural +1)  
 **Spell–like Abilities** (CL 9th):  

  3/day—detect magic, produce flame, scorching ray (1 ray)  
 1/day—pyrotechnics, wall of fire  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 25, **Dex** 17, **Con** 18, **Int** 11, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 15  
 **Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +16; **CMD** 30  
 **Feats** Blind-Fight, Cleave, Great Cleave, Great Fortitude, Improved Critical (longsword)B, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Weapon Focus (longsword), Weapon Specialization (longsword)B, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Climb +11, Fly +7, Handle Animal +10, Intimidate +10, Perception +8, Ride +5, Sense Motive +4  
 **Languages** Common  
 **SQ** armor training  
 **Gear** +1 half-plate, +1 heavy steel shield, +1 longsword  

**Special Abilities**

 **Heat (Ex)** A cheitan’s body deals 1d3 points of extra fire damage whenever it hits in melee with a natural attack or in each round it maintains a hold while grappling.
